purpose: Synthetic staging reservation vectors; no native compatibility claim
materialization: In an owned temporary root, copy baseManifest to environment.json and write memberUtf8 to every manifest member. Do not finalize or rename the staging directory.
aliasAssertion: Materialize physicalDirectory once; assert samefile for each pathSpelling. Do not create separate directories or mock path identity.
publishSetup: Use each spelling as destination, both existing and absent, with an absolute temporary repositoryRoot and deployment Build/Output/x64/Test. Rejection precedes deployment inspection, copying, native work and staging creation.
preservation: Snapshot the entire temporary tree containing a separate valid finalized Environment and initialized state. Failed requests must preserve all paths and bytes. init-state must reject both fresh and existing stateRoot without writes.
finalizedControl: Materialize a separate ordinary environment root; verify exits 0, success true, error null and returns the base manifest environmentId.
